charts.title: HD 50554 c: orbits around HD 50554
charts.description: The orbits of HD 50554's planets in this map from above, to scale, with HD 50554 c highlighted and the direction to Earth down. Each orbit is the one the app draws, from the published period, a/R*, eccentricity and argument of periastron; the star is a marker, not to scale.

metadata.orbitSource: Liu et al. 2026 (2026AJ....172...72L), via the NASA Exoplanet Archive ps table (pl_refname LIU_ET_AL_2026): P 5.969362 d

charts.title: HD 50554 c: its transit
charts.description: HD 50554 c crossing its star, as TESS recorded it: 3 sectors (45, 71, 72) of the SPOC pipeline's 2-minute light curves of TIC 80224448, each transit divided by a straight line fitted to the light either side and folded onto the orbit the app draws, moved 4 minutes earlier to where TESS measures the dip, inside the published ephemeris's 3-sigma uncertainty of 10 minutes at these dates, then averaged in 13-minute bins. Error bars are each bin's standard error.
notes: Aligned on TESS's dip, 4 min early; 13-min bins.
The ephemeris's own 1σ there is 3 min.
Bars: standard error of each bin.
